summary: PowerBank Corporation, a Toronto-based renewable energy developer listed on Nasdaq and Cboe Canada, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 29, 2026 press release reporting fiscal year 2026 results for the period ended June 30, 2026. Revenue fell to C$27.4 million from C$41.5 million as the company shifted from project sales to ownership; gross margin rose to 34.7% from 25.3%, IPP production revenue reached C$9.8 million, and net loss narrowed to C$24.3 million from C$31.1 million. The release also constitutes a designated news release under the company's June 2025 prospectus supplement. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch for continued working capital and financing needs given the C$12.8 million operating cash outflow.
